headline: Graph-based, haplotype-aware, and learned methods refine variant calling across…
label: Structural Variant Calling Methods
summary: Long-read and tumor-only sequencing increasingly demand haplotype-aware, pangenome-based, and learned variant callers.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational variant calling that exploits richer structure than per-read heuristics: haplotype information, pangenome graphs, or learned scoring. LongPhase-TO builds a unified germline-somatic graph to reconstruct somatic haplotypes from tumor-only long reads, reporting gains in haplotype N50 and somatic SNV/indel F1. SVPG uses haplotype-resolved pangenome references for structural variant detection from long reads and accelerates pangenome graph augmentation roughly tenfold. NanoTS applies deep learning to SNP calling from nanopore transcriptome reads, with F1 above 0.980 for direct RNA and 0.966 for cDNA. dicast applies machine learning to rescore short-read structural variant calls using alignment and genomic-context features. Songbird extends wavelet-based modeling to single-cell copy number calling with whole genome duplication awareness, a different data modality that shares the emphasis on model structure.
